name: Compressible & Hypersonic Aerodynamics Calculator
description: Compressible flow, shock waves and heat, explained in plain language: isentropic flow, normal/oblique/conical shocks, Prandtl-Meyer expansion, shock tube/tunnel, standard atmosphere with wind pressure, and real-gas hypersonic aerothermodynamics (equilibrium + finite-rate + two-temperature). Works fully offline.
